answer: Mechanism: quadratic vote pricing. Casting influence v over a candidate costs v^2 reputation credits. Flow: (1) each candidate binds to one graph vertex; (2) votes post with escrowed credits to a public mirror ledger; (3) each voter feeds max 5 credits per epoch into the vote river; (4) credits lock 12 epochs and burn on identity default. Attacker cost: budget C split over N fakes yields N*sqrt(C/N)=sqrt(NC) influence. With C=1000, N=16: 1000 escrowed credits buy 126.5 units versus 31.6 honest - 16x deposits for 4x pull; default burns its share.
